extension.summary: Simple Wizard is a lightweight template for installing builds on Kodi. Has some code from Aftermath Wizard by Surfacingx. Skin Switch by OpenELEQ. Base code by BYB. Credits to them and all others who contributed. Please report any bugs to @slamious on Telegram/Twitter.
extension.news: v3.9.1: Arabic no longer shows as empty boxes on a fresh install. The wizard Main Menu is a plugin directory listing whose font is set by the active skin, not the wizard; when that skin's font (or Kodi's default fallback arial.ttf) has no Arabic glyphs the labels render as tofu. The wizard now installs an Arabic-capable global fallback font into media/fonts/arial.ttf at startup (and when the menu is opened, so it works even before a restart) - every skin falls back to it, so the menu and the wizard's popups become readable. Self-sufficient: prefers the font shipped by ABUKARIM TOOLS when present, else uses the copy now shipped inside the wizard. Takes effect on the next Kodi start; only rewritten when it actually differs. v3.9: Fixed shortcuts/widgets not refreshing on Arctic Fuse 3 - traced to AF3's own Home.xml onload (Action_BuildShortcuts_OnLoad), which already calls script.skinvariables to rebuild on every skin load, but only actually rebuilds if the Shortcuts.RebuildDateTime skin string has changed since it last checked (same mechanism as exiting AF3's shortcuts editor). Patch GUI now bumps that skin string to a fresh timestamp before ReloadSkin(), so the existing rebuild path fires correctly. Harmless no-op on skins that don't use this string v3.8: Removed the generated-includes cache-clear entirely. Inspection of Arctic Fuse 3's actual skin source showed script-skinvariables-includes.xml / script-skinviewtypes-includes.xml ship as real, static skin content (viewtype rules, percent-played variables) already correct at install - not a stale cache - so deleting them was destroying working skin files, not refreshing anything. Patch GUI now only extracts the patch zip and calls ReloadSkin(); any regeneration need is a packaging concern for the GUI patch zip itself, not something the wizard should force v3.7: Reverted the v3.6 script.skinvariables/skinviewtypes cache-delete - that addon only rebuilds when its own source template hash changes, not because its output file is missing, so deleting it was actively breaking Arctic Fuse 3 (missing includes/parse errors) until manually fixed via the shortcuts editor. Only the script.skinshortcuts cache-clear (confirmed safe) remains v3.6: Patch GUI's generated-includes cache clear now also covers script.skinvariables (script-skinvariables-includes.xml, script-skinviewtypes-includes.xml) in addition to script.skinshortcuts, since Arctic Fuse 3 uses skinvariables rather than skinshortcuts for its menu/widgets v3.5: Fixed Patch GUI calling Skin.Reset with no parameter (that builtin resets one named skin setting and requires it - was erroring and never actually reloading the skin); now correctly calls ReloadSkin(), which properly triggers shortcuts/widget refresh on all skins including Arctic Fuse 3. Arabic translation folder corrected to resource.language.ar_sa (matches Kodi's actual Arabic language addon id) and translations updated v3.4: Added Arabic translation (resource.language.ar); Patch GUI now also force-clears the active skin's cached script-skinshortcuts-includes.xml before Skin.Reset so shortcuts/widgets refresh automatically on skins (e.g. Arctic Fuse 3) that don't rebuild them on every skin load v3.3: Added "Patch GUI" menu item (Build Menu / Maintenance) - downloads the current build's GUI zip from Builds.txt and overwrites GUI/skin files in place without wiping the build, then runs Skin.Reset v3.2: Notify uses Arial font (Arabic support); notify pops automatically on build updates; startup save-items window removed; fixed Build Update menu item opening Advanced Settings
